terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A wall-mounted enclosure. The door is hinged in life, but at ONE draw call and ONE material it cannot be a separate mesh, so it ships sealed as part of the body and gets no pivot: a pivot on a part that cannot move independently would be a promise the prop cannot keep. One root pivot at the wall face, zero sockets. On every shophouse pillar and soi wall; usually in rows of three to six. Pale grey enamel with rust at the door head and around the fixings, yellowed warning labels, a black flexible conduit and a brass gland below.

reasoning: ONE merge: four ROUNDED-RECTANGLE extrudes (flange r 30 mm, rim r 30, gasket r 24, door r 20; 16-point profiles, 60 triangles each), a top mounting lip, six black rim screws, the latch barrel and tab, a swept conduit with its hex nut, a brass gland with its hex nut -- 600 triangles, ONE draw call.

One material: white enamel with vertex colours for the side tones (flange #c4c7ca, rim #aeb1b4, gasket #2e2e30, conduit #262626, brass #a8843a) and ONE baked 512 x 640 WebP atlas of the plate's own front elevation, ratio-normalised over the door enamel, sampled by every +Z face through a planar UV and pinned to one clean texel elsewhere -- the printed labels, screw heads, gasket line, bevel highlight and rust arrive on the same shader.
No repetition system at one draw call.
Action readiness: one root pivot at the wall face, zero sockets, one cylinder collider on the root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the layered rounded front -- flange, rim, gasket line, door -- and the two printed labels; each layer is a rounded extrude standing proud of the one behind so the reveals shade themselves, and the front atlas carries the print and wear the geometry cannot.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.30 x 0.40 x 0.16 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=800 triangles, <=1 draw calls, <=1 materials, <=2 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; cylinder collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 0.30 x 0.38 rounded flange 12 mm thick on the wall with a mounting lip; a 0.275 x 0.362 rounded rim body to 0.127; a door 0.226 x 0.315 standing 15 mm proud inside a dark gasket line; six black screws on the rim; a latch on the right; a conduit and a brass gland hanging 0.07 and 0.03 m below the flange.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: Every station is a PLATE PIXEL at S = 0.30 m / 589 px (the flange width): flange x 218..806 y 75..815 (0.299 x 0.377), rim 240..780 / 95..805 (0.275 x 0.362), gasket 283..742 / 158..792 (0.234 x 0.323), door 291..734 / 166..784 (0.226 x 0.315). y +0.205 (mounting lip) to -0.253 (conduit tip), 0.46 against the declared 0.40 with the stubs hanging 0.07 below the flange; z 0 at the wall to 0.151 at the latch (declared 0.16), the depth stack read off the proxy END view: flange 12 mm, body to 0.127, door 15 mm proud. Proxy: w:h:d 1:1.536:0.588 -- 0.46 m tall at 0.30 wide because it carries the stubs -- and 0.176 deep; occupancy reads the flange full width at 0.98 H and the door 0.56-0.96 H spanning cols 3-76 of 80.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to w:h:d 1:1.536:0.588. The plate is a near-frontal elevation on a white matte, so the depth is the proxy's only: 0.176 m against the declared 0.16, within a gland's length.

geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Each front layer is a smaller rounded extrude standing proud of the one behind: flange/rim, rim/gasket, gasket/door are OPPOSED butt joints with a reveal; screws and the latch stand 2-3 mm proud on their own cylinders; the stubs enter the flange foot as interpenetrating cylinders.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: White enamel with a baked front-elevation atlas on every +Z face and vertex tones on the rest; gasket, conduit, brass as vertex colours.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: At the origin the asset declares. A STATIC prop: nothing opens, turns or swings, so one root pivot is the whole mechanism inventory and that is the correct answer, not a gap.

collider.notes: Declared on the asset as cylinder: one proxy about the wall normal spanning the flange diagonal, 0.16 m deep.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/enamel.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.900. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.region: two warning labels on the door
localOverrides.evidence: crops/label.png -- #c3b397 sd 61 with the print; carried as the plate's own print in the front atlas, WARNING header and triangle legible at prop distance.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-enamel (0.90) at #a3a6a6 sd 3 -- a flat swatch on a WHITE matte, so the plate exposure is high and the material is carried at #b9bcbf on the door and body, #a6a9ac on the flange, as vertex colours on a WHITE material.

Textureless as DECLARED: one baked 512 x 640 WebP atlas (22 KB) bound after construction -- the plate crop x 200..824 y 60..835 divided by the door enamel (linear 0.368/0.381/0.382) and clamped at 1.35, so the vertex base #d4d7da x atlas lands the door at #b9bcbf.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the small class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

materials.note: enamel only: 1 of 1; six tones as vertex colours.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 600 of 800: four 16-point rounded extrudes at 60 each, two boxes, ten 6/8-segment cylinders, one 5-point swept tube.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Rounded-rectangle extrudes for the flange, rim, gasket and door; boxes for the mounting lip and latch tab; cylinders for the screws, latch barrel, nuts and gland; a swept tube for the conduit.
No InstancedMesh at one draw call. In a scene the HOST instances the whole box along a wall.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One baked 512 x 640 front atlas after construction (22 KB WebP, ~1.3 MB of texture VRAM), guarded for plain Node.

risks.description: The plate is a WHITE product matte, not the grey backdrop, so its crop means run bright.
risks.mitigation: Albedo carried 10% under the crop mean on the body; the label and brass tones are read relative to it.

risks.description: Built 0.46 m tall against the declared 0.40 because the stubs hang below the box.
risks.mitigation: The box proper is 0.377 m within the flange; the stubs are the proxy's 1.536 h/w reading, recorded here.
